summary: TRX Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q3 2026 preliminary results: record plant throughput of 1,833 tpd, gold production of 7,426 ounces (up 58% YoY), and reaffirmed full-year guidance of 25,000–30,000 ounces. The release highlights operational improvements, such as higher gold recovery (84.6%) and record GIC inventory, not a special situation event. As a foreign private issuer providing routine operational updates under Rule 13a-16, this does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The registrant is the filer issuing standard operating results.
